about_the_game:
Glowkeeper is a puzzle game about manipulating elements. By the light of fireflies, link and dissolve elemental forces to construct bridges, break through obstacles, and traverse a glowing, interconnected world.

Features (Demo):

  • Introductory puzzles built around an intuitive linking mechanic that’s easy to grasp, yet builds upon itself to create layers and layers of challenge.

  • Teasers for some unexpected mechanics you'll get to explore in the full game.

  • A gentle difficulty curve with approachable puzzles for everyone.

  • A carefully-designed hint system that nudges you toward a solution while still letting you experience the thrill of a eureka! moment on your own.

  • Unlimited undos and restarts — go at your own pace with no fear of making mistakes.

  • With your firefly friend, learn the depths of this story set in a luminescent, ethereal landscape — unravel its secrets, mend what is broken, and change the fate of the world.
